title: Reference Mach number
overview: Reference Mach number loaded by NsCom::Init and used to derive the compressible-flow thermodynamic scaling constant const_cp = 1 / ((gama_ref - 1) * mach_ref^2).
principle: The Mach number is a nondimensional reference quantity. In the current implementation it enters the derived constant quadratically in the denominator. This establishes the implemented dependency, but does not by itself specify admissible values, a zero-value policy, or a complete nondimensionalization contract.
architecture: NsCom::Init reads mach_ref from the runtime parameter database and computes const_cp from gamma_ref and mach_ref. Downstream use of const_cp is a separate dependency trace and is not claimed complete by this first parameter contract.

proves: NsCom::Init reads mach_ref as a Real value.
The initialization expression uses mach_ref squared in the denominator of const_cp.
does_not_prove: An admissible numeric range or explicit zero-Mach validation policy.
Physical correctness or accuracy of a particular simulation.

verification.reference: NsCom::Init mach_ref read and const_cp derivation
verification.scope: Source-backed initialization expression; no test execution or independent physical verification is implied.
